description: Plan a flow of paid x402 services for a goal, paid with $0.02 of platform credits. Credential: a full-access Studio token (sgl_pat_*, mcp:*) or a Singularity Cloud API key with compute:write and spend. Nothing found = not charged. Use the same idempotencyKey to retry without a second charge.

goal.description: What you want done, in plain words (3 to 600 characters)

idempotencyKey.description: Your id for this request; a retry with the same id and goal is never charged twice

maxSteps.description: At most this many steps (1 to 5)

networks.description: Only services payable on these networks, e.g. ["base","solana"]
